notes.title: Support us on Patreon!
notes.content:
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/chillasart

We need your help.

First, We are just 2 people working 24/7 making games and often our work overwhelms us so we would like to outsource and expand our team in the future if possible.

Second, we want to deliver higher quality content for each game we make for the fans!

Third, you could take advantage of the Patreon tiers we put out! We will put some exclusive news of our current project(s) and even get an early steam key!



Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/chillasart

Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/ChillasArt

You play as a vlogger ready to take on one of the most haunted places in Japan.

notes.title: Patch Note v1.02
notes.content:
Patch Note v1.02

Release Notes

[Main Menu]
- Changed the font on the main menu
- Changed  from Japanese to 日本語
- Added sound effects

[Map]
- Added a small new content to support the story
- Improved lighting
- New location for diary page 9
- Added fences and boulders around the map
- The goat now animates and...

[Gameplay]
- Disabled unnecessary keyboard keys
- Unmoveable when loading at the entrance now
- Papers outside are now easily seen
- Fixed floating pages
- Character's height slightly adjusted (exterior)
- Disabled tilt shift
- Disabled motion blur

More fixes and additional contents coming.
Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Patch note v1.01
notes.content:
Release Notes for Evie v1.01

- Fixed page numbers

- Added keyboard & mouse control map in the main menu

- Added a new quality setting for low-end PCs

- Added a static goat (watching you)

- Slightly easier to see the diary papers now

- Diary page 15 moved a bit

We didn't fix all the known bugs, yet.
We are trying our best to fix as much as possible.
Thank you for your patience.
